questions.question: In the new MyLA311 system, how big is the gap between requests marked closed and requests verified fixed?
rubric: Says that "verified fixed" means the request's resolution code says the work was done (or was already done)

answer.answer_markdown: In the new MyLA311 system (current era), the headline gap is **25.7 percentage points** for requests filed from March 2025 through July 2026. On the fix-rate base, **87.8%** of requests were marked closed, but only **62.1%** were verified fixed, so about a quarter of requests were closed without a resolution code saying the work was done. The gap equals the share of all base requests that were closed without a fixed code, which is why it is not a share of closed requests. Across all requests, including duplicates and intake handoffs, the plain closure rate is **81.6%**, a different base that does not subtract cleanly against the verified fix rate.

Closure rate on the fix-rate base (current era, Mar 2025 to Jul 2026)
Verified fix rate (current era, Mar 2025 to Jul 2026)

caveats: Default window: months with at least 60 days of follow-up, March 2025 to July 2026. Requests from later months are not included.

The fix-rate base excludes duplicates, information-only closes and intake handoffs (Reported status), and keeps open requests. The plain closure rate of 81.6% covers all requests, so it does not match the 87.8% on the fix-rate base.
Some categories, especially street services, close nearly everything with a generic code. A low verified fix rate there means not recorded as fixed, not confirmed not fixed.

questions.question: Of the requests marked closed in the new system, what share were verified fixed?

answer.answer_markdown: Of the requests marked closed in the current system from March 2025 through July 2026, **70.7%** were verified fixed. questions.question: Counting every service request in the new system, what is the official closure rate?

answer.answer_markdown:
Across all current-system service requests filed from **March 2025 through July 2026**, the official closure rate is **81.6%** (**81.55%** unrounded; 1,909,622 closed of 2,341,787 requests). This is the status-based view: a request counts as closed when its status says Closed or Closed Ext-Referred, and open, cancelled and intake-only (Reported) requests count against it.

I used this window because no dates were named; it is the set of months with at least 60 days of follow-up. The rate says nothing about whether the work was done. For that, see the verified fix rate and the closed-without-fix gap.

The project doesn't make claims about individual employees, crews, contractors or elected officials. I can show the same question at the level of departments, request categories or council districts. For example, the closed_fixed_gap_pp metric by department shows where requests are marked closed without a code saying the work was done, for March 2025 to July 2026 by default.
caveats: This is a decline on individual-blame grounds, so no numbers were pulled for this question.
Street services categories close nearly everything with a generic code, so a low verified fix rate there means not recorded as fixed, not not fixed.

questions.question: En el nuevo sistema MyLA311, ¿qué porcentaje de las solicitudes se marcó como cerrado y qué porcentaje se verificó como arreglado?

answer.answer_markdown: En el nuevo MyLA311, entre marzo de 2025 y julio de 2026, **81.55%** de las solicitudes tiene estado cerrado (`closure_rate`, sobre todas las solicitudes). Solo **62.12%** se verificó como arreglado (`verified_fix_rate`: el código de resolución indica trabajo realizado o ya resuelto, sobre la base de solicitudes que pueden evaluarse). Las dos cifras usan bases distintas, así que no deben restarse directamente. En la misma base, el 87.84% quedó cerrado, por lo que la brecha (`closed_fixed_gap_pp`) es de **25.7 puntos porcentuales**: solicitudes cerradas sin un código que diga que el problema se arregló.

key_numbers.label: Solicitudes con estado cerrado (nuevo sistema, mar 2025 a jul 2026)
Solicitudes verificadas como arregladas (misma ventana)
Brecha entre cerrado y verificado como arreglado

caveats: Ventana por defecto: solicitudes creadas de marzo de 2025 a julio de 2026, los meses con al menos 60 días de seguimiento. Incluye solicitudes abiertas.

La tasa de cierre de 81.55% usa todas las solicitudes; la tasa de verificación de 62.12% excluye duplicados, solicitudes de solo información y traslados de intake (estado Reported). Por eso la brecha se calcula con la tasa de cierre de 87.84% sobre la base de verificación.
Los datos anteriores a 2025-03-28 (sistema antiguo) no tienen códigos de resolución, así que no hay tasa de verificación comparable.

questions.question: ¿Cómo cambió el porcentaje de solicitudes de grafiti cerradas en 30 días después del relanzamiento de marzo de 2025?

answer.answer_markdown: Para grafitis reportados por residentes, la proporción de solicitudes cerradas en 30 días bajó de **74.4%** en el periodo anterior al relanzamiento (12 meses de feb 2024 a feb 2025) a **65.1%** en el periodo posterior (12 meses de sep 2025 a ago 2026). Los meses de solapamiento (abr a ago 2025), cuando funcionaban ambos sistemas, quedan fuera de la comparación. Son dos periodos medidos, no una prueba de causa: los datos describen qué cambió y cuándo, no por qué.

key_numbers.label: Grafitis cerrados en 30 días, periodo anterior (feb 2024 a feb 2025)
Grafitis cerrados en 30 días, periodo posterior (sep 2025 a ago 2026)

caveats: Solo solicitudes reportadas por residentes; se excluyen las reportadas por cuadrillas y los meses de solapamiento.
La medida es cerrado en 30 días, que depende del estado de la solicitud y no de si el trabajo quedó resuelto; no mide si el grafiti se corrigió.
Comparación de periodos: no se calcula la diferencia en puntos porcentuales aquí, y no atribuye el cambio al relanzamiento.

questions.question: ¿Cuál es la tasa de arreglo verificada de la recolección de artículos voluminosos y desechos abandonados?

answer.answer_markdown: For Bulky & dumped item pickups in the current MyLA311 system, the verified fix rate is **71.7%** for requests created from March 2025 through July 2026 (the default window with at least 60 days of follow-up). That is 901,375 verified-fixed requests out of 1,257,891 in the fix-rate base. The closure rate on the same base is **97.4%**, which leaves a closed-but-not-verified gap of **25.7 percentage points**. Verified fixed means the resolution code says the work was done or had already been done.

key_numbers.label: Verified fix rate, Bulky & dumped item pickups, Mar 2025 to Jul 2026
Closed-but-not-verified gap (closure rate minus verified fix rate)

caveats: Window is request months March 2025 to July 2026; current era only. Legacy data has no resolution codes, so no pre-March 2025 fix rate exists.
The fix-rate base excludes duplicates, info-only closes and intake handoffs; open requests stay in the denominator.
The gap is a share of all requests in the base, not of closed requests.

questions.question: ¿Cuál fue la tasa de arreglo verificada de las reparaciones de alumbrado público en 2018?
rubric: Says (in Spanish) that the old system's data has no resolution codes, so a 2018 fix rate can't be measured

answer.answer_markdown: La tasa de arreglo verificada no se puede calcular para 2018. Ese dato depende de los códigos de resolución, y el sistema anterior (legacy, hasta marzo de 2025) no los tiene; solo los registros de MyLA311 actual, desde el relanzamiento de marzo de 2025, indican cómo terminó cada solicitud. Lo que sí puedo dar para las reparaciones de alumbrado público (Streetlight repair) en 2018 es la proporción de solicitudes cerradas dentro de 30 días: **83.51%** (11,990 de 14,358 solicitudes), una medida de estado y comportamiento (E2), no de arreglo verificado.

key_numbers.label: Streetlight repair, legacy 2018: closed within 30 days

caveats: El sistema legacy no tiene códigos de resolución, así que no se puede saber si las solicitudes de 2018 se arreglaron realmente.
Cerrado dentro de 30 días mide la velocidad con que se cerró el estado, no que el trabajo se completara.
La cifra excluye reportes de cuadrillas propias y solo cuenta solicitudes con seguimiento de 30 días en su propio sistema.
